## The Hospitality Staffing Reality

Hotels, restaurants, and resorts face the highest turnover rate of any industry at 73%. Every departure means retraining, service gaps, and guest complaints. You need reliable professionals who can step in and deliver from the first shift.

Seasonal demand is extreme. Summer resort bookings, holiday restaurant surges, wedding season at venues, and conference hotel blocks all demand 2-3x your base staffing. Year-round headcount does not solve seasonal peaks.

Frontline hospitality is not task completion. It is guest experience. You need shift managers who can run a floor, front desk staff who can upsell, event coordinators who can handle crises, and kitchen managers who can maintain quality under pressure.

### The TaasFlow Solution

- Hotel operations: front desk, housekeeping management, revenue management, and guest relations
- Restaurant management: FOH managers, kitchen coordinators, and F&B directors with high-volume experience
- Resort staffing: activities coordinators, spa managers, and concierge professionals
- Event staffing: planners, day-of coordinators, catering managers, and venue operations
- Shift-ready professionals who can cover weekends, holidays, and overnight schedules
